title: 3dToutcount
description: Calculates the number of 'outliers' in a 3D+time dataset at each time point.

output_prefix.description: Prefix of the new dataset saved with the outlier Q values, applicable with the -save option
output_prefix.title: Output prefix

mask_dataset.description: Only count voxels in the provided mask dataset
mask_dataset.title: Mask dataset

q_threshold.description: Use 'q' instead of 0.001 in the calculation of alpha. Must be within range 0 < q < 1.
q_threshold.title: Q threshold

autoclip.description: Clip off 'small' voxels (as in 3dClipLevel). Cannot use with -mask.
autoclip.title: Autoclip flag

automask.description: Automatically mask the dataset. Cannot use with -mask.
automask.title: Automask flag

fraction.description: Output the fraction of (masked) voxels which are outliers at each time point, instead of the count.
fraction.title: Fraction flag

range.description: Print out median+3.5*MAD of outlier count with each time point.
range.title: Range flag

polort_order.description: Detrend each voxel time series with polynomials of order 'nn'. Default value is 0, which removes the median.
polort_order.title: Polort order

legendre.description: Use Legendre polynomials for detrending (also allows -polort > 3).
legendre.title: Legendre flag
